ui.title: QGIS Agent
suggestions: Add an OpenStreetMap basemap and zoom to Europe
Import https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datasets/geo-countries/master/data/countries.geojson and colour the countries by continent
Load the traffic signals of the current view from OpenStreetMap and label them
Buffer the loaded points by 100 m, count the overlaps and style the result
Share this view as a snapshot link

agent.hints: No model is configured in this deployment: the agent settings (gear in the workspace) take an OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic endpoint and key, and a local Ollama is detected automatically. Data: 'osm' (type overpass) loads OpenStreetMap features — sources_load with source 'osm', a bbox and a collection (traffic_signals, crossings, stop_signs, motorway_junctions, roads, railways, buildings, parking, construction, tunnels_bridges) or tag filters such as 'amenity=cafe'. Typical flow: basemaps_use OpenStreetMap, layers_add or sources_load, layer_style_set, layers_zoom_to, then a short summary with counts. Sharing needs a cloud mount (mounts_add, or the preset's mounts): project_share stores a snapshot there and returns a ?share= link; view_link is the live recipe.
